content.title: Reach company, legal, and social destinations
content.description: A visitor who needs company, investor, press, legal, privacy, security, or social-channel information uses the public website’s company navigation and footer to reach those external or corporate destinations from the anonymous experience.
content.summary: Use public company/footer links to reach corporate, legal, and social information.
content.value: Supports corporate discovery and compliance access without requiring an account.
criteria: Legal and corporate links include Careers, Twilio.org, Press, Investor relations, Legal, Privacy, Security, Impressum, and Sitemap.
Social links open in a new tab with appropriate rel attributes and accessible names.
The sitemap link resolves to a valid XML sitemap, and the machine-readable llms.txt resolves successfully.
Company navigation includes About us, Values, Diversity, Careers, Twilio.org, Investor relations, Press, and Events.
